definition.summary: Pre-norm causal decoder stack with grouped-query attention, RoPE with YaRN scaling and a gated FFN, as a template.
definition.description: A template primitive: its meaning is the family of graphs its template `decoder-causal-yarn.json` denotes, one per assignment of `width`, `layers`, `heads`, `kv_heads`, `head_dim`, `inner`, `eps` and `precision`. Invoking it costs a consumer nothing beyond the primitives the template cites (§8.1); parameters, state and costs are derived from the expanded template (§4.6).
